posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
MOG_EventIndicators creates all its indicators on map load, so indicators on spawned events don't get created until you open and close the menu or use SceneManager.goto(Scene_Map) since the spawned events weren't there on initial map load.
Anyone have any idea on how to add the indicator for a spawned event without reloading the map?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
cant you use something like:
$gameMap.requestRefresh()
if they got spawned?
or motionRefresh or around that?
I think also on which spawned event plugin you use if the scriptcall doesn't
work with the spawned event.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
$gameMap.requestRefresh() doesn't help. You have to use
SceneManager.goto(Scene_Map)
It also doesn't seem to matter which spawner you use. I've tried it with Ritter and QJ Event Spawner. If you check SceneManager._scene._spriteset._eventIndicators the spawned event indicators don't get created until you reload the map.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
AquaEcho
AquaEcho
posts.body:
I figured it out. You can use
SceneManager._scene._spriteset.createEventIndicators()
right after spawning an event to draw any new indicators.
